title: BUG (AI health, HIGH): agent reports a blocker and stops instead of solving it. 2026-10-26 NUC: ff-only pull refused (local commit bbd808f4a) -> I stopped; merge refused (dirty SUPERVISOR_LOG.md, already backed up) -> I stopped and handed the operator a choice. Solution was non-destructive and in reach: commit the file, git merge origin/fast-track; it worked first try when the operator pushed. Contradictions: (1) the order 'if git refuses because of SUPERVISOR_LOG.md, report and stop' vs CLAUDE.md 'never wait on a question, take the safe default, zero operator input' and 'no want-me-to offers'; I obeyed the stop clause literally and read 'do not discard or reset' as 'do nothing'; (2) 'no rebase/reset/stash' read as a ban on all merges/commits; (3) end-of-turn wrap_up/ask habit turns every blocker into a question. Fix: rule in CLAUDE.md/roles: on a refusal list 2-3 non-destructive fixes (backup exists -> commit, merge, worktree), try the safest, verify, and only report after trying; 'report and stop' orders mean report AND continue unless it says HALT; add a test/checklist in STANDING rules and brief templates. Also stop pattern: complain then idle.
